title: BetterSensi
description: This mod allows you to put decimal values as Minecraft's sensitivity through some Minecraft commands.
body:
# Better Sensi

**This mod changes Minecraft's normal sensitivity into precise Decimal values allowing precise and efficient sensitivity adjustments beyond the vanilla sensitivity limitations!**

# Commands:


```
/setsensitivity <value>
/getsensitivity <value>
/resetsensitivity <value>
```

# What does these commands do?

**'/setsensitivity'** command takes an integer/decimal input from the user and applies it to the game for example : **/setsensitivity 24.75**

The **'/getsensitivity'** command displays your current sensitivity in the Minecraft chat when the command is runned.

The **'/resetsensitivity'** command resets your sensitivity to 50%

## This mod is designed especially for minecraft PvP
